 Malik Willis Passing Yards Pick for Dolphins vs. Lions 
 NFL 
 Sports Betting Picks 
 DraftKings Sportsbook Insights 
 Player Props 
 Published: 
 November 8, 2026 
 By: 
 Alex Hunter 
 The Dolphins are hosting the Lions on Sunday for a Week 9 matchup. On DraftKings Sportsbook , Detroit is favored by 6.5 points and this game carries a total of 49.5 points.
 Let’s dive into the top Malik Willis prop bet for Sunday’s matchup. *]:mx-auto lg:[&>*]:mx-0"> 
 Best Malik Willis Prop Bet on DraftKings Sportsbook
 Malik Willis O 207.5 Passing Yards (-113) 
 Willis has been subpar as a passer this season, averaging 6.9 YPA, but he has cleared 207.5 passing yards in 4-of-7 games, including in two straight contests entering this week. Now, Willis gets his best matchup of the season, facing the Lions on his home field. 
 Quarterbacks have flourished against Detroit this season. This defense is allowing the second-most passing yards in the NFL (2,091) and all seven of the quarterbacks that have faced the Lions have finished with at least 210 yards. Opponents have the second-highest passing success rate in the league when going against Detroit and its offense ranks eighth in pace, which translates into many shootouts.
 This game’s 49.5-point total on DraftKings Sportsbook is the third-highest for Week 9 and this is the largest total Willis has competed in this season. Willis should have a season-best performance in this spot and easily clear 207.5 yards.
